items.title: Bob Lovett Interview, 1949-04-01
items.q: Did you ever see Louis Zachera at the Victory Club?

ctx.x: Oh yeah, sure. Half the keys were missing.

They wouldn't be. There was a little fellow played trumpet, played it badly, but tried very hard to imitate Louis by the name of Louis Zachera. Did you ever see Louis Zachera at the Victory Club? I remember him. Year after year, he'd be a frequent visitor. I don't remember the name. Louis Zachera once had a job running a freight elevator. And somebody said, Louis, I understand you're the best freight elevator in the world. And Louis looked at him and said, you know, I'd rather be the worst trumpet player than the…
I used to go there quite a lot because I knew people who were working there like Don Yule and Dick Wells did. I used to like to hear Sidney Bechet who was working there for a while.
